rules.description: Ensures category identifiers are not empty strings when present.

impact.reason: Empty identifiers break lookups and downstream joins.

rules.description: Ensures category names contain at least one character when present.

impact.reason: Blank names hinder reporting and UI display.

rules.rule: (categories.is_active = false) OR (categories.department IS NOT NULL AND categories.department != '')
rules.description: Active categories must have a department assigned.

impact.reason: Missing department for active categories impedes hierarchy and routing logic.

rules.rule: (categories.is_active = false) OR (categories.category_name IS NOT NULL AND categories.category_name != '')
rules.description: Active categories must have a non‑empty name.

impact.reason: Unnamed active categories cause confusion in catalogs and analytics.
